title: Move your notes out of Notion
summary: Export your workspace, then convert it into ordinary Markdown files you can keep in a folder and back up with Git.
label: Convert an HTML or Docx export to Markdown
note: Notion also has a built-in Markdown & CSV export. Expect to tidy filenames and internal links by hand.

title: Move your budget out of YNAB
from: YNAB and other cloud budgeting apps
summary: Export your transactions as CSV, convert them into a double-entry journal, and keep that file in Git.
label: Check the ledger and print balances
note: Run this after you have converted your CSV into a Beancount file.

title: Keep a local copy of your email
summary: Download your mailbox so every message is a plain file on your disk, then search it offline.
label: Sync, index, then search
cmd: mbsync -a && notmuch new && notmuch search "tag:inbox AND date:2026.."
note: Needs a one-time ~/.mbsyncrc and 'notmuch setup' first.

title: Own your CAD and electronics designs
from: Cloud CAD and proprietary EDA tools
summary: Export existing models as STEP files to keep them, and write new parts as code so they rebuild the same way every time.
label: Build a parametric part offline
note: OpenSCAD cannot import STEP. Use FreeCAD or CadQuery to edit existing STEP geometry.
